audit.why: Taliyah wins early on Q range (1000 vs 850 Avengerang), Akshan takes over at 6 with Comeuppance plus Heroic Swing roam threat, Taliyah reclaims teamfights late — matches content layer and 49.16% over 592 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart contradicted content and packet on every row: Akshan on rows 0-3 and 6 (content says Taliyah), Skill on rows 4-5 (content says Akshan). Whys were owner-generic templates.
audit.why: Packet levelChart and content win[] agree exactly and are kit-coherent (Akshan's spike is his level-6 ult and lethality item, not levels 1-5). Full layer was wholesale wrong.
audit.corrected: All seven full sides aligned to the content chart with grounded whys and ratings.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown digits (Heroic Swing 18s, R 100s); Dirty Fighting shield-absorbs-burst interaction (flagged missing) absent; W-interrupts-swing and E-stuns-swing stated only in content, not full.
audit.why: Kit: E 18/16.5/15/13.5/12, R 100/85/70, P three-hit shield. Taliyah W displaces him off the swing; her E stuns dashes.
audit.corrected: Folded into cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d, phases whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8] advised anti-heal into Akshan, whose kit has a shield passive, not sustain.
audit.why: No heal flag in kit; Zhonya's clause retargeted at Comeuppance instead.

edits.before: Q on fresh ground shreds level-1 trades — most mids don't expect five stones at minute two. Manage your Worked Ground like mana.
edits.after: Your 1000-range Q outranges his 850 Avengerang — poke him off the wave from fresh ground and manage Worked Ground like mana.

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: W online: shove him backward out of a greedy Avengerang angle and the trade is free damage.

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones before his three-hit passive shield builds.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke every wave contact; he must step to caster minions and your fresh ground taxes each step.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Level 6 tips to him: Comeuppance plus Heroic Swing gives dive and pick threat — his camouflage roams outpace your wall.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: Lethality spike: his E swing dodges your telegraphed W and he out-skirmishes — fight only where stones pre-seed cover.

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late you reclaim it: E stuns him mid-swing, the wall cuts his flank angles, and Q zones whoever stands on your stones.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Seismic Shove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 — his engage and escape in one; fight while it is down, and E-stun him mid-swing when it isn't. - His R is 100s to your 180s. - W Seismic Shove (14s) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: The moment Heroic Swing starts, W-shove him — knocked off the rope into your E-field, the escape becomes the stun that kills him.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: His three-hit Dirty Fighting passive shields him mid-trade — force the shield out with poke before you commit the W-E burst.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the post-6 roam pattern; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — the stopwatch covers your cast-time windows. Add anti-heal early into his sustain.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Luden's Companion into Sorcerer's, then Shadowflame and Rabadon's. Zhonya's vs dive — stasis covers your cast windows and eats his stored Comeuppance bullets.

notes: Full-layer level chart was wholesale wrong (all seven rows disagreed with content/packet, which agree with each other and the kit) — aligned full to content, so no win[N] edits were needed. Anti-heal advice removed: Akshan's Dirty Fighting is a shield, not sustain. The one missingInteraction (shield absorbs burst) folded into dontsFull[2].d and phases[2].why. All four lintFindings fixed.
